Dave Matthews Band
May 11, 2022
Moody Center - Austin, TX

Taper: Mark Terrell
Source: Schoeps MK4 (Cardioid) > Baby nBox > Tascam DR-05X (24/48)
Location: Floor, Left of FOH, Approx. 125' from Stage, Mics DIN @ 10'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.57 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing) > Audacity 3.1.3 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)
